scope: Read-only reassessment of a completed pilot; original request and generation bytes unchanged. No new model or Lean call.

tool_input.command:
sed -n 3094,3188p Strata/Transform/CallElimCorrect.lean > /tmp/orig_body_$$.txt; python3 - <<'EOF'
import re,glob
p=sorted(glob.glob('/tmp/orig_body_*.txt'))[-1]
s=open(p).read()
print(len(s.split()))
print(len(re.findall(r'\w+|[^\s\w]', s)))
print(len(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9'.]*|\d+|[^\s]", s)))
print(len(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_0-9'.?!]+|[^\s]", s)))
EOF
tool_input.description: Calibrate token counting on original proof
Show toolchain version and installed toolchains

tool_input.command: python tools.py check candidate.lean | python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps({k:d[k] for k in ['scores','source_tokens','primary_heartbeats','accepted_as_best']}, indent=1)); print(json.dumps(d['correctness'], indent=1)[:4000])"

assumptions: Reasoning is included in output tokens.
Local Lean checks carry no model API charge; their returned text is counted in subsequent input.
Service tier and region are pricing assumptions, not verified billing metadata.
For aggregates, the selected context band is an assumption for every underlying request.
Codex subscription charges and future API cache-write behavior are not inferred.
Claude Code's reported cost is a client-side API-equivalent estimate, not an invoice.
All reported attempts and auxiliary models are included in the CLI estimate.
The independent aggregate repricing assumes Opus and five-minute cache writes; inspect modelUsage for auxiliary models.
Input tokens include cache reads/writes; reasoning is already included in output.
